tldr: Jupiter in the 2nd house: growth becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Jupiter in the 2nd house, this part of you expands through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
